stopPoints.label: Pororo catches a shark
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'What big animal jumped out of the water?'
Options: 'A) A small fish. B) A big shark.'
Guidance: 'It is a big shark! Let's say: Big shark!'

stopPoints.label: Poby posing on one leg
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Poby is a big white bear. Is he standing on one leg or two legs?'
Guidance: 'He is standing on one leg! Can you stand on one leg too?'

stopPoints.label: Harry the bird is singing
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is the little pink bird doing?'
Guidance: 'The bird is singing! Tweet, tweet!'

stopPoints.label: Talking about cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'Loopy made something yummy. What are they going to eat?'
Guidance: 'They are going to eat cookies! Yummy cookies!'

stopPoints.label: Crong ruins the painting
stopPoints.question:
Question (Colors): 'Oh no! What color did Crong use to draw on the picture?'
Guidance: 'He used purple! Let's say: Purple!'

stopPoints.label: Going outside to play
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are they going outside to play?'
Guidance: 'Yes, they are! They want to play outside.'

stopPoints.label: The spaceship in the sky
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'Look at the sky! What is flying over the trees?'
Guidance: 'It is a spaceship! A big flying spaceship.'

stopPoints.label: Spaceship lands in the snow
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'The spaceship landed in the forest. Is there green grass or white snow?'
Guidance: 'There is white snow! It looks very cold.'

stopPoints.label: Aliens thinking about cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'The little aliens are hungry. What are they thinking about?'
Guidance: 'They are thinking about the cookies!'

stopPoints.label: Poby hiding behind a tree
stopPoints.question:
Question (Prepositions): 'They are playing hide-and-seek. Where is Poby hiding?'
Guidance: 'He is hiding BEHIND the tree!'

stopPoints.label: Aliens eating cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What are the two aliens doing at the table?'
Guidance: 'They are eating the cookies! Munch, munch!'

stopPoints.label: Blue alien spits green paint
stopPoints.question:
Question (Colors): 'Oh no! What color is on the purple alien's face now?'
Guidance: 'It is green! The paint is green.'

stopPoints.label: Aliens holding the picture
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'What are the aliens holding and looking at?'
Guidance: 'They are looking at the picture!'

stopPoints.label: Aliens flying around the house
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Are the aliens walking on the floor or flying in the air?'
Guidance: 'They are flying!'

stopPoints.label: The messy house
stopPoints.question:
Question (Opposites): 'Look at the room! Is the room clean or very messy?'
Guidance: 'It is very messy! Everything is on the floor.'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and friends come back
stopPoints.question:
Question (Comprehension): 'Who opened the door and came back inside?'
Guidance: 'Pororo and his friends came back!'

stopPoints.label: Holding a small plant
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What is the alien holding in his hands?'
Options: 'A) A small plant. B) A toy car.'
Guidance: 'He is holding a small plant!'

stopPoints.label: Spraying water
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'What is coming out of the little bottle?'
Guidance: 'Water is coming out! They are playing with water.'
